title: Design configuration validation for per-type workflow bindings
description:
Design how kanbus.yml should validate that:
1. Each issue type has a workflow binding
2. Workflow transitions are enforced
3. Configuration errors are detected at load time

Related to configuration_standardization.feature scenarios that are currently marked @wip.
creator: ryan.porter

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: Closed as delivered. The per-type workflow binding validation and dual-runtime specification steps are present on develop (including Python config_loader.py and Rust config_loader.rs); commits e68875e4 and a0a55bff are ancestors of origin/develop.
